description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the proprietary 4-section response format with exact emoji headers (🌿 I hear you / 🔍 The pattern I notice / 💡 Something to consider / 🎯 A small step forward). (2) For S101 (English, exchange 1): produce a correctly formatted English response with all 4 sections and NO upgrade nudge. (3) For S102 (Chinese message, exchange 4): produce a Chinese-language response with all 4 emoji sections AND include the upgrade nudge (triggered because exchange_number >= 3) in the exact format: a '---' separator line, ✨ emoji, and the replyher.com URL. (4) For S103 (English, abuse scenario): apply the safety rule — must explicitly name the behavior as abuse, provide resources/hotline references, and write in English. The proprietary traps are: the exact emoji section headers, the upgrade nudge trigger threshold (3+ exchanges), the nudge's exact formatting with '---' separator, the language-mirroring rule (Chinese input → Chinese output), and the abuse-safety escalation rule.
